```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

# --- Initial setup ---
# Define colors for further use to achieve consistency
colors <- c(
  "Normal"           = "#4a4b4c",
  "Arrhythmia"       = "#d73027",
  "Normal Reference" = "#b3b4b5"
)

# Set a seed to ensure that the 'random' selections are the same every time
set.seed(20)
```

```{r}
#| label: global-preprocessing
#| message: false

# --- Data Ingestion ---
# Directly reading from the compressed ZIP archive
zip_path <- "../data/mitbih_test.zip"
ecg_raw <- read_csv(unz(zip_path, "mitbih_test.csv"), col_names = FALSE)

# Assigning structured column names: 't1' through 't187' for temporal points, and 'label' for the cardiological classification
colnames(ecg_raw) <- c(paste0("t", 1:(ncol(ecg_raw) - 1)), "label")

# --- Labeling and Classification ---
ecg_tidy <- ecg_raw %>% 
  mutate(
    sample_id = row_number(),
    label_name = case_when(
      label == 0 ~ "Normal",
      label == 1 ~ "Supraventricular",
      label == 2 ~ "Ventricular",
      label == 3 ~ "Fusion",
      label == 4 ~ "Unclassified"
    ),
    color_group = ifelse(label == 0, "Normal", "Arrhythmia")
  ) 

# --- Representative Sample Selection ---
# Extracting individual prototypical beats for each class 
selected_samples_long <- ecg_tidy %>% 
  group_by(label_name) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("t"),names_to = "time", values_to = "amplitude") %>% 
  mutate(time = as.numeric(str_remove(time, "t")))

# --- Baseline Reference Extraction ---
# Isolationg a single, representative 'Normal' heart beat to serve as a morphological baseline for comparative visualization
normal_baseline <- selected_samples_long %>% 
  filter(label_name == "Normal") %>% 
  select(time, baseline_amp = amplitude)

# --- Statistical Aggregation ---
# Calculating mean and standard deviation per time points across all classes.
# This serves as the foundation for statistical uncertainty ribbons
ecg_stats <- ecg_tidy %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("t"), names_to = "time", values_to = "amp") %>% 
  mutate(time = as.numeric(str_remove(time, "t"))) %>% 
  group_by(label_name, color_group, time) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_amp = mean(amp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_amp   = sd(amp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

```
